maxRiskPerTrade.description: Maximum risk per individual trade (0.5% to 1%)

maxDailyLoss.description: Maximum portfolio loss allowed in a single day

maxWeeklyLoss.description: Maximum portfolio loss allowed in a calendar week

maxOpenTrades.description: Maximum number of open positions at any time

consecutiveLossLimit.description: Stop trading after this many consecutive losses

doublingDown.description: Doubling down on losing positions is strictly forbidden

emergencyKillSwitch.description: Emergency kill switch pauses all trading activity

maxPositionSize.description: Maximum single position size as percentage of capital

maxDrawdown.description: Maximum portfolio drawdown before mandatory shutdown
